notes.title: Ancient Islands Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello Islanders!
      We are carefully read all your feedback and investigate all suggestion on the fly.

Currently we have fixed the following issues:

1. Improved camera behavior:
The camera following the clicked object. If you click a barely visible building, the camera will follow it and you should see the building buttons.

2. The ability points now proper count when victory is achieved.


Please share your gameplay experience with us - join our discord!


cheers,
AGS Team

notes.title: Ancient Islands Hotfix #1: V-Sync added!
notes.content:
Hello Islanders!
       We've added V-Sync to the game settings menu, to help you tame your framerate.
When V-Sync option is enabled, the game matches the maximum refresh rate to the monitor. This reduces the number of frames per second generated by the graphics card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812847/db110b00ddf12999f660ffc8d97b29b1ed0a4ceb.png[/img]


cheers,
AGS Team

notes.title: Ancient Masters - Enter the contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812847/574f59cf8f10411458625bba9d1ad7e0158da59c.png[/img]
[h3][b]We've got an opportunity for you to show your tactical sense and grab a game key in the process![/b][/h3]

From now on you'll be able to send us your high scores using the [b]CONTEST[/b] button in the games menu and paste the code generated in the dedicated discord channel (CTRL+V) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812847/9d3704fd1334168b8946459ed738d7e70d1d5dbf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41812847/f1ed2950a2aa2527a6e2a66ab8902f93de9da626.png[/img]

[b]Five people with the best score (stars on the game map) will receive:[/b]
[b]-exclusive discord title - "THE ANCIENT 🗿"[/b]
[b]-a Steam key of his/her choice:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199910/SWAN_Chernobyl_Unexplored/]S.W.A.N.: Chernobyl Unexplored [/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059230/When_I_Was_Young/ ]When I Was Young[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1498900/Chefs_Tail/]Chef's Tail[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1084710/Climbros/]Climbros[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1177170/Pooplers/]Pooplers[/url]
[b]-Shout out on the announcement channel and our social media [/b]

[b]Keep in mind that easy will only allow you to get 2 stars ⭐ per level, medium 3 ⭐, and hard 4 ⭐ ![/b]

Any draws will be resolved on a first come first serve basis.
[b]The contest will last till the end of the Steam Next Fest (28th of February)
glhf[/b]
